title: thelypteris rotumaensis
intro: Thelypteris rotumaensis, commonly known as Rotuma fern, is a species of fern native to the Pacific Islands. It is a plant used in traditional medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rotuma fern include pain relief, wound healing, and immune system support, attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. These constituents contribute to its therapeutic effects, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine and a subject of ongoing scientific research.
